anxiety.definition: The speaker describes their own worry, fear, or nervousness.
examples: I am worried about tomorrow's exam.
I feel nervous all the time.

social_support.definition: The speaker describes receiving emotional or practical help from another person.
examples: My friend listened and helped me feel less alone.
My sister helped me when I was struggling.

self_management.definition: The speaker describes an action they take to manage their own mental health outside of formal treatment.
examples: I take a walk to manage my stress.
I journal every morning to track my moods.
